title: Zephyr: state machine
description: Implement desync state machine for Zephyr C. Acceptance: Works on constrained devices.
close_reason: Invalid: This is a feature implementation task (implement CCP FSM for Zephyr C), not a bug fix. The bead requests new functionality to be written. Parent epic l1qw.2.11.1 (Python FSM) is complete and can serve as reference. Current Zephyr C code only has basic sync flag in time_sync.c - requires implementing the 4-state machine (UNJOINED/JOINED/DRIFT/RECOVER) with state transition handlers on_join, on_beacon, on_drift_warn, on_drift_max, on_give_up, on_leave per spec 2a.6 CCP-13a.
